summary: Bench bumped 0.29.2 -> 0.30.2 and H3 nodes verified registered; the open question is feasibility, not wiring. Smallest usable weight set is 53.9 GB against 53.7 GB free on G: and 16 GB VRAM on the 4060 Ti. Engine stays pinned at 0.29.2 until this card returns a go.

Picked up for bench research. Storage moves off G: to C:/AI (205.8 GB free), so the 53.7 GB ceiling in the brief no longer binds. Weight matrix, variant meanings and the turbo-LoRA question researched; a UK licence exclusion surfaced as the real blocker.

Maturity corrected from 'research' to 'in-progress'. The card was moved todo -> doing, and 'research' is a todo-only value: doing allows only in-progress or validating. Scope is unchanged - this stays an investigation card, which the title, description and acceptance carry.

Licence blocker analysed against the full text: the UK/EU/US/KR carve-out covers Outputs too, so watermarking buys nothing and free/open-source buys nothing. Not re-hosting the weights is the one real mitigation. A formal licence request was prepared; details are held outside this repo.

MiniMax H3 licence route resolved: MiniMax runs an official request form for excluded territories, linked from docs/QA-about-License.md in the H3 repo. A request was submitted 2026-08-05 and authorization was granted the same day. Request and approval details are held outside this repo under a confidentiality undertaking. Consequence for the app: a user consent gate in front of the H3 download is required before H3 can ship.

UMBRELLA SCOPE, decided by the user: no separate card for the engine bump. MPI-449 owns the whole H3 arc - bench research, the go/no-go, then running MPI-451 (licence gate) and bumping the engine 0.29.2 -> 0.30.x, before handing to MPI-452 for model wiring. Fresh sessions carry state via mpi-handoff. Progress: all five weight files downloaded to C:/AI and checksum-verified; encoder is ethanfel's abliterated int8 26.36 GB (complete vision tower kept in BF16) over Comfy-Org's 27.14 GB, with int4 rejected on ApacheOne's published 18-19 percent worst-layer RMSE that also hits the vision tower. H3 RUNS on the 4060 Ti 16 GB - 131 s warm, 20 steps, 640x640 x 56 frames, 6.55 s/step - which answers acceptance criterion 1. MINIMAX_H3_RATIOS shipped to js/utils/ratios.js in commit f739e076, inert until a ModelDef references it. The 0.30.0 node floor is now recorded as a hard second gate on MPI-452. BLOCKED: a Cubric-Prompt agent is running prompt-enhancement tests with Ollama on the same GPU, so every timing is an upper bound and the clean re-run waits on it.

note: Built the two-stage latent staging nodes in the sibling repo c:/AI/Mpi/ComfyUi-MpiNodes (new latent.py, registered in __init__.py, README + changelog). MpiSaveLatent writes <output>/latents/<name>.latent and gates downstream with the same continue/block boolean as MpiBlocker; MpiLoadLatent reads it back and continues. Core SaveLatent crashes on an H3 latent because NestedTensor has no .contiguous(), so the pair is split with unbind() into latent_tensor_0/1 and rebuilt on load. comfy.nested_tensor is imported inside the function, never at module scope, so the pack still loads on the app engine at 0.29.2. Single-tensor files stay byte-compatible with core LoadLatent. Verified by a round-trip harness under the bench python: H3-shaped pair, plain tensor, core LoadLatent reading our file, missing-file blocker and the path helper all pass. Live registration on the bench still needs a ComfyUI restart. These nodes are generic (they would clean up the WAN workflow too) and were folded under MPI-449 rather than carded.

Session close-out. Two-stage H3 sampling PROVED: SplitSigmas 5/15 plus a latent round-tripped through disk is bit-for-bit equal to a single-stage run, +1.4 s (+4%). Four nodes shipped to ComfyUi-MpiNodes and pushed (HEAD fd9bdca): MpiSaveLatent, MpiLoadLatent, MpiBooleanInvert, MpiH3Length, plus a lazy-input fix to MpiBlocker. Structural finding, now in docs/workflow-authoring/mpi-nodes.md: ExecutionBlocker only travels downstream and an OUTPUT_NODE is always executed, so gating after a sampler never stopped the sampler - which is why the wan22 _stage2 twins exist with Stage1_Bypass deleted. Both forcing paths are now fixable with lazy gates, so those twins can likely go (LTX six differ by ONE baked boolean). H3 cannot produce whole seconds: n%17==5 at 24 fps means 2 s is really 2.33 s (56 frames, measured on a real mp4); 8 s is the shortest exact one. H3 does not repeat frames (56 decoded, 56 unique), so the WAN/LTX remove-frame node is unnecessary. App seek needs no change - MpiVideoControlBar derives effFps from frameCount/duration. OPEN RISK: every measurement on this card ran at 56 frames and the trained range is 124-362, so the 5-step preview floor, the pruned/unpruned A/B and the timing table are all provisional - re-run at 124 before they become tier defaults. Card stays doing/in-progress.

IN-RANGE re-measurement at 124 frames / 352x608, the shortest TRAINED length - closes most of the section 9 warning. Correctness re-proved in range: the two-run save/load flow, the same flow re-run at a different seed, and split-in-one-pass all produced the SAME mp4 sha256 (4464f9fd), and two independent stage-1 runs wrote the SAME latent sha256 (301843b7). So the safetensors round-trip is lossless at 2.2x the latent shape it was proved at, and the save path is deterministic. The lazy gate was PROVED, not assumed: the first stage-2 run showed node 153 in execution_cached, which cannot tell pruned from cached, so it was re-run at a never-sampled seed (99, free because DisableNoise ignores the seed on a continue) - node 153 stayed out of the cache list and the run still took 112.25 s against 143-168 s for a real 20-step pass. Second proof: with enabled false, stage 2 left the staged latent hash AND mtime untouched. TIMINGS REPLACED: single-pass 168.25 s (seed 4) and 143.51 s (seed 5), stage 1 51.00 s, stage 2 112.25 s pruned / 118.92 s cached, two-stage total 163.25-169.92 s. The headline correction - two single-pass runs of the SAME graph differ by 24.7 s (~15%), so the +1.4 s / +4% overhead measured at 56 frames is BELOW run-to-run noise at 124 and must not be quoted as a percentage; say within noise. STILL OPEN in range: the 5-step preview floor (no 5/6/7/8 A/B was run at 124) and the pruned vs unpruned weights A/B. Also note the in-range session changed resolution to 352x608, so it replaces the old table rather than extending it. Separately: dev_configs/node_lock.json pinned 69a4333 -> fd9bdcae56a6792cbc6d39756b7dfe51d20596e0 (verified present on origin/main; h3.py is pure python and latent.py only adds an ExecutionBlocker import that if_else.py already shipped, so the pack still loads on the 0.29.2 app engine). Card stays doing/in-progress.

Pruned vs unpruned RE-CONFIRMED by the user at higher canvases (480x864 and 768x1344, 56 frames, seed 4, 20 steps, same prompt and source, only unet_name varied). Spatial quality EQUAL at both - confirms the 2026-08-05 call at a 2.7x larger canvas. NEW FINDING: the difference is TEMPORAL, not spatial - unpruned is slightly more expressive in facial motion (wider smile, more eye crinkle) on the same seed; pruned is more restrained. User judged it not worth 13 GB. Decision stands, ship pruned, but the REASON is narrower than it looked: speed is dead as an argument (pruned was 23.8 s faster at 768x1344 but 4.6 s SLOWER at 480x864 - the sign flips and both sit inside the ~25 s run-to-run spread), and resident memory was already dead since 2026-08-05 (ComfyUI streams per layer, footprint capped by what fits not by file size). The only real argument left is DOWNLOAD SIZE, 20.97 GB vs 34.04 GB, which for a shipped product is decisive on its own. CAVEAT carried into section 9: the expressiveness gap was seen at 56 frames, under half the trained minimum, and a temporal signature is exactly what would compound over 124-362 frames - so the row is cleared for spatial quality and STILL OPEN for motion at length. Also recorded in section 5b: (1) MINIMAX_H3_RATIOS is one tier SHORT by this repo own convention - ratios.js:56-58 already ships WAN an above-native very_high at 1920x1088 called an extrapolated detail tier, and H3 would extrapolate LESS (1.43x vs WAN 1.50x), both /32-clean; the template Note: Size Settings Reference reaching 2.0 MP is NOT evidence, it is the generic ResolutionSelector column byte-identical across all three templates. (2) Resolution trades texture for cleanliness - higher canvas means less noise and less morphing but plastic skin, because more latent cells let the model render its own clean-skin prior; the texture at 480x864 is capacity-limited decode texture, NOT retained source grain (same source across both canvases, and high-frequency is stripped by lanczos + the /16 encode before the model sees it). Product consequence: grain belongs in a post pass, not in a tier choice.

Two decisions closed by the user. (1) PRUNED IS FINAL and the unpruned file is DELETED: minimax_h3_fl2va_int8_convrot.safetensors, 34,038,892,334 bytes, removed from C:/AI/diffusion_models/ at the user instruction after the 768x1344 A/B, 31.7 GiB reclaimed, C: now 144 G free. Bench was idle and both recent runs used the pruned file, so nothing held a handle. MPI-452 dependency entry takes minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors, 20,970,379,616 bytes. Re-downloadable from Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3 if the long-clip caveat ever forces a re-test. (2) RESOLUTION SETTLED: ship very_high = 1088x1920 matching WAN and LTX, decided after running it at 56 frames against 768x1344; the user rated the eye rendering better than any open-source model seen. THE COST RECLASSIFIES THE TIER: scaling is steeply superlinear because attention is quadratic in token count - 0.41 MP 157 s, 1.03 MP 467 s, 2.09 MP 1537 s, so 2x pixels costs 3.3x time. 25.6 minutes for a 2.33 s clip and roughly an hour at 124 frames, making very_high a FINAL-RENDER tier rather than an iterate tier, which is exactly the case the two-stage preview flow exists to serve. Memory is NOT the limit: 13.2/16 GB dedicated at 2.09 MP, LOWER than the 14.7 GB at 640x640, because ComfyUI keeps fewer weights resident to leave room for activations - memory has now failed as a predictor for H3 in both directions, by file size and by canvas size. Also recorded: composition is NOT seed-stable across a canvas change (different latent shape means a different sample, seen as the subject framed nearer in one tier and further in another), so a tier A/B can never be read as same shot sharper. OPEN for MPI-452: the ladder shift. very_high must not simply overwrite 768x1344 or the native in-distribution canvas leaves the picker; WAN puts its native at high and the extrapolated at very_high, which for H3 gives very_low 352x608, low 480x864, medium 640x1152, high 768x1344 native, very_high 1088x1920, dropping 416x736. Not yet applied to ratios.js - awaiting the user call on whether MPI-449 or MPI-452 owns that edit.

Three user decisions applied. (1) LADDER SHIFTED IN CODE - js/utils/ratios.js MINIMAX_H3_RATIOS restructured so NATIVE sits at high and the extrapolated tier at very_high, mirroring WAN exactly: very_low 352x608, low 480x864, medium 640x1152, high 768x1344 (native, adapt_canvas output), very_high 1088x1920 (above trained canvas). Old 416x736 tier dropped. Safe because the only consumers are ratios.js itself (BUILTIN map line 488) and the deepFreeze list; the exhaustive test iterates tiers generically. VERIFIED: node --test tests/ratio*.test.cjs 5/5 pass, eslint clean, every value /32-clean, MP ladder 0.21/0.41/0.74/1.03/2.09. Comment block rewritten - the old claim that 1:1 tops out at 768x768 was scoped to the NATIVE tier, and the NO 2K/4K note now says very_high is a detail tier not a 2K pass. (2) 5-STEP PREVIEW FLOOR CLOSED by user decision, not by measurement - accepted as-is, section 9 row marked decided so nobody re-opens it as a measurement task. (3) H3 SHIPS 6 LORA SLOTS WITH BOTH STRENGTHS, new section 4a. The encoder genuinely influences output: the TE runs ONCE in the node (nodes_minimax_h3.py:141-142) and its cond feeds every step, and because the clip is the qwen3vl VL TOWER taking images=images it also shapes how the model reads the KEYFRAME, not just the text. Needs NO UI work - MpiModelSettings already renders LORA_COUNT=6 slots and loraStrengths defaults to [model,clip] at line 598, so MPI-452 just leaves loraStrengths unset and uses LoraLoader instead of LoraLoaderModelOnly. Note this makes H3 the FIRST model here with a clip path; all 19 existing LoRA nodes are LoraLoaderModelOnly. TRAP recorded: model_lora_keys_unet has 17 named branches and H3 is not one, so a Diffusers-format H3 LoRA loads without error and silently does nothing. Also recorded that an encoder LoRA is the wrong lever for skin texture (conditioning steers semantics; texture is DiT+VAE) and that the 32B encoder is a far heavier training target than the DiT.

summary: Closed on the user's call 2026-08-08. This was the feasibility research card and it produced its answer in full: H3 ships as TWO models (minimax-h3 fl2va and minimax-h3-ref2va), both generating, with the findings written up across docs/models/h3/ (README, performance.md, ref2va.md). Nothing about it is still open - the follow-on work has its own cards.
